stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: qual_functions
stages.query: SELECT f.*,(SELECT group_concat(name,'.')||'.' FROM (SELECT name FROM classes c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND f.id BETWEEN c.id AND c.last ORDER BY c.id))||f.name qualified FROM functions f

stages.name: conn_receivers
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE r(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM a WHERE kind='Name' AND name IN ('conn','connection') OR kind='Attribute' AND name IN ('conn','connection','_conn') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM r JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.receiver=r.id AND c.callee_kind='Attribute' AND c.callee='session') SELECT * FROM r

stages.name: txn_receivers
stages.query: SELECT __path,id FROM a WHERE kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND (substr(name,-3)='txn' OR kind='Attribute' AND name='_txn')

stages.name: query_chains
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE r(__path,origin,id) AS (SELECT __path,id,receiver FROM calls WHERE callee_kind='Attribute' UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,r.origin,c.receiver FROM r JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.id AND c.callee_kind='Attribute') SELECT r.__path,r.origin,c.id,c.receiver FROM r JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.id WHERE c.callee='query' AND c.callee_kind='Attribute'

stages.name: embedding_calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,coalesce(f.qualified,f.name,'<module>') qualname FROM calls n LEFT JOIN qual_functions f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.fn
